description: PREFIGURES relationships between OT types and NT antitypes, extracted from CCC

relationships.notes: The flood and Noah's ark prefigured salvation by Baptism
The ark that saved through water prefigures baptismal salvation
The cloud and the crossing of the Red Sea prefigured Baptism
The crossing of the Red Sea is a sign or type of Christ's victory
The cloud that led Israel prefigured Baptism
Water from the rock was the figure of the spiritual gifts of Christ
Manna in the desert prefigured the Eucharist, the true bread from heaven
Circumcision prefigures that 'circumcision of Christ' which is Baptism
Baptism is prefigured in the crossing of the Jordan River
The land promised to Abraham's descendants is an image of eternal life
Melchizedek is a prefiguration of the priesthood of Christ
Melchizedek's offering of bread and wine prefigures the Eucharist
Everything that the priesthood of the Old Covenant prefigured finds fulfillment in Christ
Jesus gave new and definitive meaning to the Passover blessing of bread and cup
The Church sees in OT liturgical signs a prefiguring of the sacraments of the New Covenant
